description: This PHP class 'EntityUniquePropertyOption' provides validation options for ensuring the uniqueness of a property within an entity, including features like trimming input, ignoring certain values, setting custom trim functions, and matching specific values.

classes.name: EntityUniquePropertyOption
classes.description: A class encapsulating validation rules and options for ensuring the uniqueness of a property in an entity, with configurable trimming, ignoring specific values, and matching specific values.

methods.name: isTrim
methods.description: Returns whether trimming is enabled for the property.

methods.name: setTrim
methods.description: Sets whether to trim the property value.

methods.name: getTrimFunction
methods.description: Retrieves the custom trim function used to trim input values.

methods.name: setTrimFunction
methods.description: Sets a custom function for trimming input values.

methods.name: hasIgnoreValues
methods.description: Checks if any ignore values are set for the validation.

methods.name: setIgnoreValues
methods.description: Defines specific values to ignore during validation.

methods.name: getIgnoreValues
methods.description: Retrieves the list of ignore values.

methods.name: setIgnoreId
methods.description: Adds an ID to ignore during validation, useful when updating an entity.

methods.name: getMatchValues
methods.description: Gets the set of values to match against for validation.

methods.name: setMatchValues
methods.description: Sets specific values to match during validation.

methods.name: hasMatchValues
methods.description: Checks if matching values are set for validation.
